logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: Cloud+ でクラウド運用基礎を整えたうえで、SANS SEC488 系の GCLD に進むとクラウドセキュリティ基礎の網羅性が高まる。

minus.note: クラウド入門としては CCSK / 各クラウドの基礎資格より高額。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: A one-year cloud-security profile, accreditation and consistent associate hints support an associate baseline; open-book testing and high relative cost do not justify professional delivery claims.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded DoD recognition and accreditation strengthen this one-year cloud-security essentials signal to associate level. The open-book exam and foundational scope do not establish professional cloud engineering, regardless of its price.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cloud-security essentials scope and one-year profile support associate domain knowledge. Accreditation and DoD alignment do not turn the open-book knowledge exam into demonstrated professional cloud delivery.
